plugin.name: Dragonfall_Level_Adept
plugin.author: Dragonfall
plugin.purpose: Make a test character an adept and set rank to the game max (20)
plugin.description:
Dragonfall — adept max-rank (immortal functional test)
dfadept [player] dfconfig char <name> dfshow
Examples: dfadept dfadept Testchar dfconfig char Testchar
Always: 1. setclass <player> ADEPT (no-op / error if already adept — ignore it) 2. mset <player> adept 20 3. force <player> save
Game cap is 20 (see do_mset "adept" in src/act_wiz.c).

muclient.script:
local DEFAULT_CHAR = "Testchar" local ADEPT_MAX = 20
local function say(msg) ColourNote("gold", "", "[dfadept] ", "white", "", msg) end
local function fail(msg) ColourNote("red", "", "[dfadept] ", "white", "", msg) end
local function trim(s) return (string.gsub(tostring(s or ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")) end
local function split_words(s) local out = {} for w in string.gmatch(trim(s), "%S+") do out[#out + 1] = w end return out end
local function valid_name(s) return string.match(s, "^[%a][%a%d_]*$") ~= nil end
local function get_char() local v = trim(GetVariable("char") or "") if v ~= "" then return v end return DEFAULT_CHAR end
function ShowUsage() say("usage: dfadept [player]") Note(" default: char=" .. get_char() .. " adept max=" .. tostring(ADEPT_MAX)) Note(" config: dfconfig char <name>") Note(" show: dfshow") Note(" sends: setclass <player> ADEPT") Note(" mset <player> adept " .. tostring(ADEPT_MAX)) Note(" force <player> save") Note(" requires: immortal trust 90 (setclass) and 89 (mset)") end
function DoAdeptMax(player) if not valid_name(player) then fail("bad player name '" .. tostring(player) .. "' (letters/digits/underscore)") return end
-- First-time only. If they are already adept the mud replies -- "They are already an adept." and we still raise the rank. local make = string.format("setclass %s ADEPT", player) local rank = string.format("mset %s adept %d", player, ADEPT_MAX) say(make .. " && " .. rank) Send(make) Send(rank) Send(string.format("force %s save", player)) end
function OnDfAdept(name, line, wildcards) local rest = trim(wildcards[1] or "") if rest == "help" or rest == "?" or rest == "-h" or rest == "--help" then ShowUsage() return end
local w = split_words(rest) local player = get_char() if #w >= 1 then player = w[1] end DoAdeptMax(player) end
function OnDfConfig(name, line, wildcards) local w = split_words(wildcards[1] or "") if #w == 0 then OnDfShow() return end
local key = string.lower(w[1]) local val = w[2] if key == "char" or key == "name" or key == "player" then if not val or not valid_name(val) then fail("dfconfig char <PlayerName>") return end SetVariable("char", val) say("char = " .. val) else -- class / level belong to the other plugins return end end
function OnDfShow() say("char=" .. get_char() .. " adept max=" .. tostring(ADEPT_MAX) .. " (setclass ADEPT + mset adept)") end
function OnPluginInstall() if trim(GetVariable("char") or "") == "" then SetVariable("char", DEFAULT_CHAR) end say("loaded — dfadept [player] (dfshow for defaults)") end
